description: Query-to-library dispatch checks (A2.1e brief, section 12.3, last item). Every reviewed directional call and every non-ranking relation case is reached through a hand-shaped query on a caller-chosen sub-scene that keeps only the call's objects. The expected TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN value is read from the accepted case table (directions/cases.json, relations/cases.json), never computed by the code under test. Ranking is covered by R15-R22.
query_rule: root node: the target's known category, plus the constraint (relation, frame, anchors); one anchor node per anchor object, with that object's known category. The resolver's trace must hold a predicate event for the case's exact call (target first; between's anchors compared as a set; near, symmetric and memoized canonically, compared as a set because of near(a, b) and near(b, a) only the first call is traced), with the table's value.
